# mockware

> Generate mock/stub SDK layers for embedded unit testing.

mockware parses real embedded SDK headers (ESP-IDF, etc.) into a reusable
YAML knowledge base, then generates stub header files with function-pointer
overrides for every API the project uses.

## CLI

- `mockware parse $IDF_PATH -o known_apis.yml` — build YAML knowledge base
- `mockware generate --project . --input known_apis.yml --output mock-sdk` — generate stubs

## Key pattern

Each generated function `esp_wifi_start` has:

- `esp_wifi_start_default()` — default impl returning ESP_OK
- `esp_wifi_start_fp` — overridable function pointer (extern in `*_fakes.h`)
- `esp_wifi_start()` — delegates to `_fp`

In tests, include `esp_wifi_fakes.h` or `nvs_flash_fakes.h` to get extern
`_fp` declarations instead of hand-writing them.
